name: Big Bend Campground
evidence: Esri z19: drive-in sites 3 and 4 pads ~18-24 m from the Poudre bank through a thin conifer fringe with gaps, no road between; FS map /media/71898 puts sites 1-6 on the river side (7-9 walk-in tent, not counted). On-water holds, but the Poudre is ~17-22 m wide here, under the ~30 m size rule.

name: Big Creek Campground
evidence: Esri + Wayback 2026-04-30 and 2014-04-30: camp gear at the same spot on the west loop's lake-side tip, ~28-40 m to the reservoir across an open meadow with scattered conifers, loop road behind. Grand Mesa NF, not Routt. Rec.gov 10165145 is a placeholder; no site map or photos, pad only inferred, so held at lakeview.

name: Big Creek Lakes Campground
evidence: Rec.gov 231864 site 043 (reservable, 30-ft back-in): Esri pad ~23-30 m to the sand high-water edge across open grass, footpath to water, loop road behind; site photo shows open meadow to the lake. 044/045 capped 20 ft don't count; other loops are lake views through trees at 52-76 m.

name: Big Meadows Campground
evidence: Esri plotted rec.gov 232252 pads 003-006 (30-50 ft): ~95-100 m to shore, beyond the bound, across an open grass slope with scattered conifers; 006 has a clear sightline. USGS EPQS pads ~8 m above the 2811 m pool, lake side of the dam. Only 'Riverfront' tag is tent-only group GSA; no per-site photos.

name: Big South Campground
evidence: Esri z19: site 4 RV spot ~27 m from the bank, open sand to the water (~10 m from table end), shrub clumps only, no road between; site 3 ~20-27 m; FS map /media/71909 and site photos viewed. On-water holds, but the Poudre is ~10-15 m wide here, under the ~30 m size rule.

name: Boyd Lake State Park (Cottonwood)
evidence: Cpwshop 'Lakefront' tags on 37 RV sites (loops B-F) are not on the water: plotted tagged 057 ~130 m and untagged loop A 231 ~115 m from the full-pool shore (Wayback 2023) with paved lake path and tree band between. Cpwshop photos of 058, 081, 083, 147 show open lake views. 16 of 18 sampled tagged sites had photos; all those viewed.

name: Bradfield Campground
evidence: Esri z19: NE-loop spur pad with shelter (~37.6597,-108.7362) ~38-42 m to the Dolores over open grass, ~6 m reed fringe; river ~26-28 m there. Mid-loop sites 60+ m behind a dense riparian band. Prior 'south spur' is the boat ramp/day use, which doesn't count. No site map or photos, pad only inferred, so riverview.

name: Bridge Campground
evidence: Rec.gov 10165180 site coords on Esri z19: trailers at site 15 ~10-12 m, site 17 ~16 m, 14 ~27 m and 05 ~18 m from Williams Creek through thin willow, no road between; creek ~10-14 m wide. Gallery photos of sites 1-5, 7-15, 19 all viewed: open meadow, creek hidden by willows. FCFS; no length data, trailers visible on the pads.
